# fish completion for tui-markdown (generated by `tui-markdown --completions fish`)
complete -c tui-markdown -l cat -d 'print the rendering and exit (the default when standard output is not a terminal)'
complete -c tui-markdown -l c -d 'print the rendering and exit (the default when standard output is not a terminal)'
complete -c tui-markdown -l width -x -d 'columns for --cat (default: the terminal\'s, or 80)'
complete -c tui-markdown -l w -x -d 'columns for --cat (default: the terminal\'s, or 80)'
complete -c tui-markdown -l dump -d 'print the page as the screen shows it (theme background, margins) at --width, with no terminal needed'
complete -c tui-markdown -l max-width -x -d 'widest text column, 0 for the whole window (default 100)'
complete -c tui-markdown -l theme -x -d 'dark, light, tokyonight, nightfox, gruvbox-material or plain (default: from COLORFGBG; plain when NO_COLOR is set)'
complete -c tui-markdown -l transparent -x -d 'draw on the terminal\'s own background (opacity, blur): on, popups (popups and bars) or off (default; TUI_MARKDOWN_TRANSPARENT=1|popups|0)'
complete -c tui-markdown -l scale -x -d 'H1 as scaled text (OSC 66): on, off or auto (from the environment: kitty)'
complete -c tui-markdown -l links -x -d 'OSC 8 hyperlinks: on, off or auto (from the environment: not Terminal.app or a dumb terminal)'
complete -c tui-markdown -l sync -x -d 'synchronized output (DEC 2026, asked of the terminal first): on, off or auto'
complete -c tui-markdown -l colors -x -d '16, 256 or 24bit (default: from the terminal)'
complete -c tui-markdown -l zebra -d 'shade alternate table rows'
complete -c tui-markdown -l numbers -d 'line numbers in code blocks'
complete -c tui-markdown -l side -d 'open with the outline sidebar'
complete -c tui-markdown -l mode -x -d 'start in preview, source or live (default preview)'
complete -c tui-markdown -l edit -d 'start in live mode (same as --mode live)'
complete -c tui-markdown -l smart -d 'smart typography while typing: curly quotes, en dashes, ellipses'
complete -c tui-markdown -l no-watch -d 'do not reload when the file changes'
complete -c tui-markdown -l completions -x -d 'print a shell completion script (bash, zsh or fish) and exit'
complete -c tui-markdown -l help -d 'show this help'
complete -c tui-markdown -l version -d 'print the version and exit'
